detail: RESOLVED: the initial franchise fee is $25,000. The $20,000 figure is stale copy still published on /about-us/ and mirrored into 16 KB documents, including FAQ pairs that read as standalone facts. Never write $20,000. Keep the 'starting at' and 'depending on business type' qualifiers; the fee is not a flat price.
resolution: Confirmed by automate@renegadeinsurance.com on 2026-08-26. Recorded as public.claims (approved $25,000 + prohibited $20,000) and a blocker brand_rule. Not yet cross-checked against the Franchise Disclosure Document, which is the legally controlling figure.

detail: Site meta claims quotes from '100 insurance companies' while the homepage shows only 11 carrier logos. The 11 named carriers are the verifiable set.
Agency page headers state 8:30AM-5PM while the same agencies' per-day listings state 9AM-5PM. Per-day values are the ones captured in locations data.
The Pembroke Pines page markets itself as 'Renegade Insurance Miami' and displays Miami's 305-944-3030 number. Location identity on that page is unreliable.

Agent count is stated three different ways: 'surpassed 2,000 verified agents' (2023 milestone on /about-us/), '2800+ licensed insurance agents' (/car-insurance/), and 'thousands of top-rated independent agents' (/about-us/). No specific figure is supportable.
